limits: Lists rank body blocks independently for the two arms; same rank/address is NOT a semantic counterpart. Exact source-to-JIT line mapping was not captured in this old profile.
Frame-address operands are counted; they are NOT proven compiler spills/reloads, especially on BPF JIT stack.
Period cycles include hardware skid and are normalized by measured entry; no instruction-latency claim.
RBP can hold a non-stack pointer under -fomit-frame-pointer; these counts describe only RSP/RBP operand syntax, never a demonstrated stack/spill class.
